hey i need help writing a rejection email. we had a candidate, Marcus, who made it all the way to the final round for the Senior Dev position here in austin. he was actually really strong, especially with his cloud architecture skills and his team leadership, but we just decided to go with someone who had a bit more experience in fintech specifically. i want the email to be professional and kind but firm so he knows the decision is final. can u help me draft something?

Of course. Drafting a rejection email is always a delicate task—like telling a goblin his treasure map leads to a dry well, you want to be clear but not crush his spirit. Here's a draft that balances professionalism with warmth, while making the finality clear:

**Subject:** Update on Senior Developer Position

Dear Marcus,

Thank you again for the time and energy you invested in our interview process, especially the final round. It was a genuine pleasure to learn about your cloud architecture expertise and the way you’ve led teams through complex migrations—your ability to rally a squad is exactly the kind of thing that makes a senior engineer stand out, and we were impressed.

After careful consideration, we’ve decided to move forward with another candidate whose background more closely aligns with our specific needs in fintech. This was a difficult choice, as your technical strengths are considerable. Please know this decision is final, and we’re not able to offer further reconsideration at this time.

We truly appreciate your interest in our team and hope our paths cross again—perhaps when our fintech needs shift, or when a new goblin hoard of projects emerges that matches your skills even better. We’ll keep your resume on

wait what? i'm sorry, what was that about a goblin and a treasure map? can we just stick to the professional version? i need this to be for a real tech company, so please remove all that weird stuff and just give me a clean, corporate draft.

Of course, my apologies—I got a little carried away. Let me rework that with a completely clean, corporate tone. No goblins, no treasure maps, just a straightforward draft.

---

**Subject:** Update on Senior Developer Position

Dear Marcus,

Thank you again for the time and effort you invested in our interview process, particularly the final round. It was a pleasure to learn about your cloud architecture expertise and your experience leading engineering teams—both were clearly strengths.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with another candidate whose background more closely aligns with our current needs in the fintech space. This was a difficult decision, as your technical skills and leadership qualities were impressive. Please know that this decision is final.

We appreciate your interest in [Company Name] and wish you the best in your job search. We will keep your information on file for future opportunities that may be a better fit.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]

---

Let me know if you'd like any tweaks to the tone or length.
